reason: The cited evidence supports that Nb-containing refractory HEAs form BCC solid solutions (E1, E2) and that solid-solution strengthening is key (E3), but no evidence directly addresses the Hf-to-Nb substitution in HfMoTaTiZr, its effect on density, or the retention of mechanical properties at ~1000 °C.
premises: NbMoTaTiZr retains a single BCC solid-solution phase
Substituting Hf with Nb reduces density via lower atomic mass
Solid-solution strengthening is maintained or enhanced by lattice distortion
High-temperature strength and creep resistance are preserved
Phase stability is retained under casting and homogenization conditions
